title: Closed-pushforward cohomology comparison preserves connecting maps
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $0\to A\to B\to C\to0$ be a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves on $Z_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ [def-sc-zariski-site, def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Define $(i_*D)(U)=D(U\cap Z)$ for every open $U\subseteq X$. Since $i_*$ is exact [lem-sc-closed-immersion-pushforward-exact], there is an image short exact sequence $0\to i_*A\to i_*B\to i_*C\to0$. For every global section $c\in H^0(Z_{\mathrm{Zar}},C)$, the isomorphism $H^1(Z_{\mathrm{Zar}},A)\cong H^1(X_{\mathrm{Zar}},i_*A)$ of [lem-sc-cohomology-closed-immersion-pushforward] takes the connecting class $\delta_Z(c)$ of the first sequence to the connecting class $\delta_X(i_*c)$ of the image sequence. In particular, if $C=\mathbf Z_Z$ is the constant integer sheaf and $u:\mathbf Z_X\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z$ is restriction, the boundary of $1$ for the pullback of the image sequence along $u$ is the image of $\delta_Z(1)$ under this isomorphism.
